stem: A biologist counts 2,500 bacteria in a culture. The number of bacteria increases by \(20\%\) every hour. How many bacteria will be in the culture 3 hours after the count?
solution: Each hour the number is multiplied by 1.2.
verify:
ans = 2500 * Rational(12, 10)**3
assert ans == 4320
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
